cases.title: Extension is not deactivated on closing the editor window
cases.priority_rationale: Reproducible regression affecting extension authors on closing the editor window, preventing proper deactivation and process cleanup. Workaround exists (stop debugger), but this affects extension reliability.

cases.title: Build support
cases.priority_rationale: Feature gap affecting C code development with make and gdb debugger extension. Users want to see make output window remain visible and stop launch on compile errors.

cases.title: Terminal: cursor blink stops after switching tabs
cases.priority_rationale: Reproducible regression affecting a specific UX feature (cursor blink), but with a known workaround (reopen terminal panel) and a related config option already implemented (#500).
